question: Who performs each step of a Securitize product?
answer: The recorded lifecycle separates appointment, admission, ownership records, token transport, servicing and correction. The Securitize corporate identity map remains the existing entrance for subsidiary licenses.

items.title: Securitize infrastructure anatomy
kv: Obtain or observe a public FINRA/BrokerCheck description that directly reflects the reported 2026 custody, underwriting and selling-group expansion. · Track production evidence and volumes for the NYSE digital-platform, Computershare and Continental relationships rather than treating partnership announcements as completed market migration. · Track BRSRV assets, supported chains, stablecoin-issuer use and network-outage or correction evidence separately from its launch. · Track the EU TSS opening, admitted instruments, members, settlement asset and production volumes separately from CNMV authorization. · Resolve product by product whether the official register is an off-chain control book, a composite blockchain-plus-identity register, or a linked incumbent register.

Securitize is best understood as a regulated securities-control plane rather than a blockchain or a general crypto-finance conglomerate. Its group joins transfer agency, broker-dealer and ATS functions, investment advice, fund administration, tokenization software and an EU trading-and-settlement venue while relying on outside issuers, asset managers, custodians, public networks and cash rails.

Group consolidation does not merge the licenses, appointments or duties of the named subsidiaries. A token can be part of an official shareholder register in one product, a representation reconciled to a transfer-agent control book in another, or a secondary layer attached to an incumbent registrar in a third.

The strategic asset is not a coin. It is the ability to keep the legal security, investor identity, transfer restrictions, official record, corporate actions, trading access and correction powers joined across several technical ledgers.

catalog_context.title: Who actually controls the crypto infrastructure
catalog_context.answer: Of 20 crypto networks and companies we track, only one is used at scale and none is proven under stress; many brands rest on a handful of legal providers.
